# Mathematical scope and pinned inputs

## Fixed physical input, not a theorem generated by this program

The marked group is G=SL2(F5), over the complex numbers. The identification of the distributed character table with G and its physical labeling is a pinned mathematical input. In particular, W is the chosen determinant-one doublet, A=Sym^2(W), and V is the distinct three-dimensional irreducible. Wp is the other doublet. This identification is not established merely by hashing, checking orthogonality, generating a ring, or obtaining a dimension count.

The complete public sources were read before implementation. [The immutable physical splitting/conventions source](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/read-em-and-weep/blob/db51525015bb7c5e825833d550d08dedf6f6ea96/research/hm/order-four-quadratic-load/ACTUAL-EQUIVARIANT-SPLITTING-AND-GAUSS-PERSISTENCE.md) fixes W, Wp, A, V, S4, D, T6 and P, including A=Sym^2(W). [The immutable rank-two source](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/read-em-and-weep/blob/db51525015bb7c5e825833d550d08dedf6f6ea96/research/hm/order-four-quadratic-load/RANK-TWO-GAUSS-PLATEAU-NECESSARY-BOUND.md) records W·Wp=P, W·S4=A+D, W·T6=D+V+P. [The immutable primary-terminal source](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/read-em-and-weep/blob/504b7eb800407dfc7e6340c98c72cdd553939f54/research/hm/primary-terminal-slope-obstruction/PROOF.md) records P·W=Wp+T6 in that physical marking.

SOURCE-PINS.json gives immutable public URLs, revisions, byte counts and content hashes for all six full source inputs. They motivate and fix conventions; their geometric theorems are not imported into executable requests. Those notes do not themselves display every cell of this catalog. The full table is fixed explicitly here using the exact class-character construction independently used in the source review. The table-to-group identification remains an explicit input, not an inferred consequence of the program's successful tests.

## Exact catalog

Ordered class sizes are (1,1,30,20,20,12,12,12,12), summing to 120. Write phi=(1+sqrt(5))/2 and phi_bar=(1−sqrt(5))/2. The ordered W traces are:

(2,−2,0,1,−1,phi,−phi,phi_bar,−phi_bar).

The first six character rows are S_n(x), n=0,...,5, where S_0=1, S_1=x, and S_(n+1)=x S_n−S_(n−1). They have labels 1,W,A,S4,D,T6. The P row is:

(4,4,0,1,1,−1,−1,−1,−1).

The Wp row is W·P−T6, and the V row is S_6(W)−P. Dimensions are (1,2,3,4,5,6,4,2,3); center signs are (+,−,+,−,+,−,+,−,+). The catalog includes all 81 fusion products. `build_catalog.py` regenerates these fixed, universal data using exact rational arithmetic; it does not construct a group representation or supply a proof of the marking.

Q(sqrt(5)) is represented as ordered rational pairs (a,b). Addition is componentwise; multiplication is (a,b)(c,d)=(ac+5bd,ad+bc). All catalog characters are real valued, so complex conjugation is trivial in their exact class inner products:

inner(chi,psi) = sum over classes C of |C| chi(C) psi(C) / 120.

The separate verifier checks every orthogonality entry, sum of class sizes, sum of squared dimensions, each physical symmetric-power definition, dimension and center sign, and every stored fusion product against exact class inner products. It also checks reconstruction of every evaluated character from its inner-product multiplicities. These are finite consistency checks conditional on the fixed mathematical input.

## Producer and checker separation

The producer uses only integer fusion multiplication to evaluate expressions and the usual determinant-one symmetric-power recurrence. It then emits class values by a linear combination of the fixed table.

The verifier does not import the producer or shared request-contract module. It independently validates the in-memory request grammar, evaluates addition/subtraction/tensor pointwise on the exact class table, evaluates Sym^d(W) on each fixed class, and derives irreducible coefficients by the weighted inner product. It does not accept the producer's fusion output as its arithmetic oracle. The CLI shares strict JSON ingestion, but this does not replace the verifier's own schema and arithmetic validation.

The independently authored review uses yet another symmetric-character formula, a finite binomial polynomial, and a separately implemented exact oracle. All implementations share the stated mathematical identification assumption. Algorithmic cross-checking is not formal theorem proving.

## What genuine means

For the fixed complex irreducible catalog, a virtual character is genuine exactly when every irreducible multiplicity is nonnegative. This is an abstract representation-class statement. Signed dimension being nonnegative is insufficient. Equality of dimensions, parity or a small subset of class values is insufficient to identify a representation. Signed even/odd dimensions can cancel, so parity uses irreducible support.

A genuine result does not establish that it occurs as the cohomology of an actual object, embeds in a specified bundle, is realized by an actual map, or satisfies a geometric hypothesis. A virtual result does not by itself contradict a geometric situation without a separate proof that the situation would require genuineness. No caller-supplied assertion is silently promoted into such a hypothesis.

There are no actual source coefficients or selected parameters, points, jets, matrices, instance ranks, source-domain scans or model experiments in this pack. Results are not Lean proofs and are not automatically accepted by Foundation Math or another runtime. Runtime integration, if ever requested, requires a separate reviewed boundary and explicit theorem/proof policy.
